video.title: EU4 1.36 The Papal State Guide - The Most UNDERRATED Nation For BLOBBING

phases.name: Day one setup
phases.intro: Everything here happens before you unpause.

steps.text: Summon the Diet, pick whichever agenda suits you
steps.note: You start with 50% crownland

steps.text: Clergy: Religious State, Clerical Advisory Council, Religious Diplomats, Clerical Education
Nobility: Primacy of the Nobility, Increased Levies, Aristocratic Counselors, Strong Duchies, Integration Policy
steps.note: Done in advance so subjects annex cheaply later

steps.text: Burghers: Land of Commerce, Patronage of the Arts, Commercial Advisory Board, Indebted to the Burghers
Seize land instead of selling titles
steps.note: Money is not a problem as the Pope

steps.text: Rival Provence and one other (he picks Savoy)
steps.note: Keep the third rival slot empty for Naples

steps.text: Hire a level 1 admin advisor (inflation reduction)
Hire a level 1 diplo advisor (improve relations or diplo rep)
Hire a level 1 mil advisor (discipline, morale, fort defense or manpower)
Ally Austria first
steps.note: Helps against HRE minors, or lets you join the HRE

steps.text: Ally Milan (a northern neighbour you won't fight soon)
steps.note: Next day, once relations allow

steps.text: Improve relations with France, then ally them
steps.note: Castile if France won't. France is slightly better

steps.text: Scornfully insult Naples
steps.note: Sets up excommunicating them later

steps.text: Last diplomat: build a spy network on Aragon
steps.note: For claims on Naples

steps.text: Light ships: Protect Trade in Genoa, go home during war
Queue about 5 light ships and 10 galleys
Lower army maintenance, turn off forts
Set subjects to Siege
Golden Bull: take the -5% stability cost bull now
steps.note: Or wait for the Renaissance bull if you want to help other Catholics

steps.text: Move Alexandria and Valencia merchants to collect in Genoa and Venice
Set those merchants to Establish Communities
steps.note: Lowers aggressive expansion

phases.name: First years and missions
phases.intro: Waiting on Aragon to free Naples and France to drop Provence. Use the time on missions.

steps.text: Spare diplomats: improve relations with subjects and allies
Ally France, accept their call into the England war
steps.note: You won't actually do anything there

steps.text: Catholic Conformity mission once you have 3 allies
steps.note: +100 diplo

steps.text: Improve Lithuania to 100, take their mission
steps.note: They convert their Orthodox provinces, you get devotion

steps.text: Scornfully insult a Swiss rival, max relations with Switzerland
Form the Swiss Guard mission
steps.note: +10% merc discipline for 20 years, Papal Swiss Guard costs no professionalism

steps.text: Renaissance spawns in 1450: Encourage Development edict in Lazio
steps.note: Whether or not it spawned on you

steps.text: Expand infrastructure and develop Rome to 30
steps.note: Age objective, and speeds up the Renaissance

phases.name: First war: Naples
phases.intro: Naples is free and borders you, with few or no allies. This war should be very easy.

steps.text: Aragon's ruler dies and Naples is released
steps.note: Usually by 1450. He has only seen it not happen once

steps.text: Aragon event: choose option 2 (subjugation CB)
steps.note: Don't use that CB. Subjugation forces vassalization and costs too much AE

steps.text: No claim on Naples yet? Spy on them now
Rival Naples with the empty slot
Once they rival back, excommunicate Naples if you can
steps.note: Blocked if they bought Indulgence or you like them too much

steps.text: Raise army maintenance, take loans if needed
Hire the Papal Swiss Guard mercenaries
Take the mission that gives a 62-tradition general
steps.note: Unlocks once you hire mercs, so skip recruiting a general

steps.text: Declare with Excommunicated Ruler CB, else Conquest. Call Milan
Peace at about 40 AE
steps.note: Excom CB: the bigger chunk plus money and war reparations. Conquest CB: 3 provinces, no money, so the truce ends sooner

steps.text: Meanwhile, start a spy network on Provence

phases.name: Second war: Provence
phases.intro: France always drops Provence after their war with England. Provence is left with weak allies.

steps.text: France has broken its alliance with Provence
steps.note: Check right after Naples peace

steps.text: Check Provence's allies are weak, and if you can excommunicate them
Tier 2 reform: Commercial, Protection or External Mission
steps.note: Money run: Commercial. Crusades: Protection. Conquering Europe: External

steps.text: If Commercial: new merchant in Valencia, transfer to Genoa
Diplomats improve relations with countries you've angered
Excommunicate any bordering target as soon as Papal Actions allows
steps.note: Halves AE on bordering provinces. He finally gets Naples here

steps.text: Core the Naples provinces before declaring
Get military access from France and move your army to Avignon
Declare (Excom or Conquest), call Milan and Austria
Peace: 3 southern provinces, humiliate if still rivals, money

phases.name: Consolidate
phases.intro: Take a 2 to 3 year breather. Your two openers are done.

steps.text: Annex Perugia and Urbino
New loans, embrace the Renaissance
Vatican Library mission
steps.note: Admin tech or army tradition option is slightly better. He takes army tradition

steps.text: Pay off the first burgher loans, take new ones
Marketplaces in centers of trade and estuaries (Rome, Urbino, Naples, Aix)
Churches once marketplaces are built
Seize land whenever estates are above 50 loyalty
steps.note: Keep crownland above 30%

steps.text: Italian minors in the HRE: join the HRE if you're done early (~1452), or wait
steps.note: They leave around 1462

steps.text: Periodically excommunicate anyone you might fight
steps.note: He gets Venice

steps.text: Admin tech 5: Quality ideas
Naval doctrine: galley combat ability

phases.name: Northern Italy and Naples again
phases.intro: No strict order from here. Fight whoever is easiest, always with the excommunication CB if you can.

steps.text: The Italian minors leave the HRE
Second Naples war when the truce ends
steps.note: Only if they're still independent. Excom CB, Conquest, or subjugation

steps.text: Take a few provinces and vassalize Naples, plus their money
steps.note: You'll feed them their Sicily cores later. Never conquer Sicily yourself

steps.text: Spy networks and claims on Siena, Florence, Savoy, Genoa
steps.note: Lower autonomy from time to time

steps.text: Government ability: Justified Wars
War on Siena with Milan, full annex
Tier 3 reform: Education of the Court
steps.note: Advisor discount stacks with the curia's

steps.text: Diplo-vassalize 1 or 2 province minors (Bologna, Corsica, Lucca, Saluzzo)
steps.note: Use the offer-vassalization list to see who will accept

steps.text: Get them to 190 opinion: ally, guarantee, gift, mil access, influence, subsidies, Appoint Cardinal
steps.note: Cardinal gives +50 opinion and is underrated

steps.text: Venice war while the Ottomans fight them (or with Austria)
steps.note: Excommunicate first if you border them. Call Milan

steps.text: Build Your Own Navy mission once you have the boats
Admin tech 6: workshops in high-value goods provinces
Venice peace: Istria, Zara, Spalato, Padua, Verona
steps.note: About 30 AE, no money so the truce ends faster

steps.text: Release Dalmatia as your subject
steps.note: Strong trade, army and navy ideas

steps.text: With more than 2 subjects: Strong Duchies and Integration Policy
Break the alliance with Milan once you border them

phases.name: Aragon
phases.intro: Optional, and only when Aragon is fighting someone else. In his game Castile and France were beating them.

steps.text: Aragon is weak or at war with bigger powers
Declare on Aragon (he uses reconquest of Messina)
Peace: Sicily cores to Naples, or one province to release Sicily
Take all of Sardinia
One province to release Catalonia, one to release Valencia
Use favors with France to return your subjects' cores
steps.note: Gerona in Nov 1479, Roussillon in Mar 1481

phases.name: Economy and midgame
phases.intro: Expand and build at the same time. Benchmark: about 27 ducats a month in 1480 with armies and forts up.

steps.text: Rebuild the Papal Treasury, then Restore Curia Funding
steps.note: Once loans are paid off

steps.text: Admin tech 7: Trade ideas (Europe) or Religious (crusades)
Annex diplo-vassals after 10 years. Lower autonomy
Tier 4 reform: Head of the Catholic Church
Mop up the minors left in the north (he annexes Ferrara)
Patrimony of St Peter mission (6 provinces in Marche and Emilia-Romagna)
steps.note: Permanent claims on Tuscany, Liguria, Piedmont

steps.text: Keep taking new burgher loans, upgrade centers of trade
Annex Naples once you've handed them all their cores
Prospering Times event: option 2 (new center of trade)
steps.note: Trade power went from 0.9 to 14.5 for him

steps.text: Venice again when the truce ends, with Austria
steps.note: He uses Dalmatia's claims

steps.text: Optional: hit Castile when France attacks them, for Valencia's cores
Start St Peter's Basilica once you have 1,000 ducats
steps.note: Get it to tier 1 before the commissioning event, which bumps it a tier

steps.text: Full-state everything you get from subjects
Take admin tech 8 a bit early: courthouses everywhere, in subjects too
steps.note: Fixes governing capacity

steps.text: Switch to level 2 advisors
Florence: full annex is fine now
steps.note: Few Italians left and none in the HRE, so no coalition

steps.text: Radical Reforms event: fire both advisors, take the points, rehire
Full annex Savoy
Quality and Trade done: +15% trade efficiency policy
1 to 3 nations left in Italy: merchants back to Maximize Profit and reposition
Crush the Italian Cities mission (9 provinces in Tuscany, Liguria, Piedmont)
steps.note: Claims on Venetia, Lombardy, Po

steps.text: Annex Italian vassals. Keep Dalmatia, Valencia and Catalonia
Tier 5 reform

phases.name: Finish Italy
phases.intro: Milan is usually the biggest one left, since you allied them early.

steps.text: Milan in about 3 wars, first for Genoa (5 provinces)
Conquer Trent
steps.note: Needed for the Kingdom of God

steps.text: Keep the stronger of France and Austria, break with the other
steps.note: Use one to beat the other, then turn on the first

steps.text: Subjects divert trade when they're loyal
Become Defender of the Faith
Declare the Kingdom of God

phases.name: 1507 benchmarks
phases.intro: What his game looked like when colonialism spawned.

steps.text: About 66 ducats a month, no loans, no inflation
Level 3 advisors
Courthouses, workshops, churches and marketplaces built
Every center of trade at level 2
Two full stacks at combat width
Main fleet of about 21 galleys and 10 transports, plus trade fleets in Genoa and Venice
steps.note: Later Valencia and Ragusa

steps.text: Great projects: St Peter's, Santa Maria del Fiore, Duomo di Milano, Doge's Palace, Caserta

phases.name: Later picks
phases.intro: Goal by 1550 to 1560: own the Valencia, Genoa, Venice and Ragusa trade nodes.

steps.text: Idea 3: Quantity
Idea 4: whichever of Trade or Religious you skipped
steps.note: Tall in Italy: Economic or Infrastructure instead

steps.text: Tier 6 reform: Battle Pope
Tier 7: Divine Nobility (army) or Mercantile Tithe (money)
Tier 8: Empower the Burghers or Embrace Economic Theory
Tier 9: Combat Heresy. Tier 11: Church and State. Tier 12: Religious Society
Tier 13: One State Under God or Global Crusade
Pick a path: Europe, crusades into North Africa and the Levant, or colonizing
